mapper.select: select gp.p_id as pId, prp.p_name as pName, gs.Gs_Section as gsSection, mn.* from Gantt_Tasks mn left join Gant_Section gs on gs.id=mn.gs_id left join Gantt_Plan gp on mn.plan_id=gp.plan_id left join pre_project prp on prp.p_id=gp.p_id where mn.task_id=#{taskId}

sql.if: and DATEDIFF(CAST(mn.Task_Start_Date as DATE),CAST(#{params.taskStartDate} as DATE))=0
and DATEDIFF(CAST(mn.Task_End_Date as DATE),CAST(#{params.taskEndDate} as DATE))=0
and DATEDIFF(CAST(mn.Task_Begin_Time as DATE),CAST(#{params.taskBeginTime} as DATE))=0
and DATEDIFF(CAST(mn.Task_Finish_Time as DATE),CAST(#{params.taskFinishTime} as DATE))=0
and DATEDIFF(DAY,CAST(mn.Task_Start_Date as DATE),CAST(#{params.taskStartDate} as DATE))=0
and DATEDIFF(DAY,CAST(mn.Task_End_Date as DATE),CAST(#{params.taskEndDate} as DATE))=0
and DATEDIFF(DAY,CAST(mn.Task_Begin_Time as DATE),CAST(#{params.taskBeginTime} as DATE))=0
and DATEDIFF(DAY,CAST(mn.Task_Finish_Time as DATE),CAST(#{params.taskFinishTime} as DATE))=0

mapper.select:
select count(1) from Gantt_Tasks gt left join Gantt_Plan gp on gt.Plan_Id=gp.Plan_Id where gp.Plan_State=7
and gp.Te_Id = #{teId}

select gs.gs_section as gsSection, gs.gs_describe as gsDescribe, (case when (select count(*) from Gantt_Tasks_Process p where p.Task_Id = mn.Task_Id) > 0 then true else false end) as taskFilling, (select ft.T_Name from SYS_FileTemplate ft where ft.T_Code = mn.Task_Start_T_Code limit 1) as taskStartTName, (select ft.T_Name from SYS_FileTemplate ft where ft.T_Code = mn.Task_End_T_Code limit 1) as taskEndTName, mn.* from Gantt_Tasks mn left join gant_section gs on gs.id = mn.gs_id where mn.Plan_Id = #{planId} order by Task_Sort asc
select count(1) from Gantt_Tasks mn left join Gantt_Plan gp on mn.Plan_Id = gp.Plan_Id where gp.Plan_State = 7 and mn.Task_State = 1 and mn.Task_Parent = #{params.taskId}

select count(1) from Gantt_Tasks gt left join Gantt_Plan mn on gt.Plan_Id=mn.Plan_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id left join Pre_Project pro on pro.P_Id=mn.P_Id left join SYS_Department dep on dep.D_ID=mn.Plan_D_Id left join SYS_Company c1 on pro.P_Construction_Unit=c1.C_Id ${params.authSql}

select mn.Plan_Name as planName, mn.P_Id as pId, con.Con_Name as conName,
dep.D_Name as dName, sec.Sec_Name as secName, gs.gs_section as gsSection, gs.gs_describe as gsDescribe, gt.* from Gantt_Tasks gt left join gant_section gs on gs.id=gt.gs_id left join Gantt_Plan mn on gt.Plan_Id=mn.Plan_Id left join Con_Contract con on con.Con_Id=mn.Con_Id
left join SYS_Department dep on dep.D_ID=mn.Plan_D_Id left join Sec_Info sec on sec.Sec_Id=mn.Sec_Id ${params.authSql} and mn.Plan_State=7
and gt.Task_Finish_Time is null and gt.Task_End_Date is not null andnow(),gt.Task_End_Date)>0
and gt.Task_Finish_Time is not null and gt.Task_End_Date is not null andgt.Task_Finish_Time,gt.Task_End_Date)>=0
and gt.Task_Finish_Time is null and gt.Task_End_Date is not null andnow(),gt.Task_End_Date) >= 0 andnow(),gt.Task_End_Date) <= 30
and gt.Task_End_Date is not null and ( (gt.Task_Finish_Time is not null andgt.Task_End_Date,gt.Task_Finish_Time)>0) or (gt.Task_Finish_Time is null andgt.Task_End_Date,now())>0) )
and gt.Task_Finish_Time is not null and gt.Task_End_Date is not null andgt.Task_End_Date, gt.Task_Finish_Time)>0
and gt.Task_State = 0
and mn.P_Id = #{params.pId}
and gt.Task_State = #{params.taskState}
order by mn.${params.sortFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by ${params.sortSideFiled} ${params.sortType}
order by mn.Plan_Name,gt.Task_Sort desc
